content: We validate the effectiveness of the proposed approach using a different NMT architecture RNN-Search on the Chinese$\Rightarrow $English translation task. The results are shown in Figure FIGREF20(a). We observe that the Attribution method still outperforms both Attention method and Random method by a decent margin. By comparing to Transformer, the results also reveal that the RNN-Search model is less robust to these perturbations. To be specific, under the setting of five operations and Attribution method, Transformer shows a relative decrease of $55\%$ on BLEU scores while the decline of RNN-Search model is $64\%$.
